body.statement: In the independent and identically distributed Bernoulli-treatment design with overlap, compact covariate domain and compact convex outcome domain, and continuous cost \(h\), the sharp lower endpoint over causal couplings preserving the two conditional outcome laws is the conditional optimal-transport functional \(L(P)\) in (41).
